purpose: Construct a training-only matched intervention on fragment source confidence before deciding whether new training is justified.
control: Within each128-residue length bucket, SHA-order all proteins independently of quality and assign left/center/right round-robin. Exactly one unchanged20-residue condition per protein.
candidate: Maximize total fragment mean AFDB pLDDT over the SAME proteins with exactly the SAME left/center/right counts in each length bucket. Use only existing, independently encoded fragment inputs. No coordinate changes, new encoding, target filtering, refold selection, or development data.
gate: These prospectively declared confidence-separation gates establish whether a meaningful matched input-quality experiment is feasible. They do not certify designability or authorize skipping matched40-update GPU profiles. Preserve a failed gate without relaxing it.
scope: CPU preparation only. Subsequent paired training must use identical parent, frozen-generator policy, protein/noise/time/dropout/LR draws, condition count and length/placement frequencies. Record expected condition-identity differences explicitly. Both arms restrict training to one20-residue fragment per protein, so comparisons to earlier12-condition recipes are descriptive only. Training-source confidence can covary with fragment structure and sequence; do not claim a pure confidence effect. No evaluation labels enter this selection.
